title: Concept: Compose file served with credentials
description: A compose file that carries database passwords in the environment block in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The file states every service with its credentials, which is a complete map of the stack and the secrets that join it together.
applicability: Deployments that render a compose file that carries database passwords in the environment block into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The file states every service with its credentials, which is a complete map of the stack and the secrets that join it together.
